digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service initialization and per-operation binding composition
propositions: Long-running MCP and review-bot processes re-read static Gerrit/GitHub/LLM/telemetry config on each operation, causing inconsistent application of deployment policy and requiring restart/redeploy to bind changes

MCP inbound bearer tokens and request auth material must remain transient request context and never enter startup snapshots, operation snapshots, serialization, logs, caches, or subprocess environments

Review-bot validates decision-bearing auth (Gerrit/GitHub credentials) lazily inside per-operation handlers rather than before accepting work, and does not forward composed LLMRuntime to adapter decision code

Static binding composition must be performed once at service startup and remain stable across environment/file mutations; only a restarted process observes rotated material, while SDK-native refreshable capabilities remain SDK-owned
Telemetry setup (Langfuse/OTLP) with partial or rejected credentials must fail open and disable telemetry without changing the underlying operation result, while load-bearing auth remains fail-closed
